summary.zh: 读写编辑 Word 文档并生成规范排版
summary.en: Create, read and edit Word documents with professional formatting.

description.zh: 支持创建、读取和编辑 .docx 与 .dotx，可处理目录、标题、页码、表格、页眉，也能换图、查找替换和查看修订批注。适合把零散素材整理成报告、信函或模板。使用前需要安装文档处理依赖。
description.en: Creates, reads and edits .docx and .dotx files with headings, TOCs, page numbers, images, find-and-replace and tracked changes. Suits turning loose material into reports or templates. Needs document libraries installed.
